digest.component_or_area: Jira sync external integration test suite
propositions: Live-Cloud rehearsal against non-existent project keys (REBEMPTY, REBGHOST) fails with Jira parse-error ('the value does not exist for the field project') and aborts the entire pass because the inbound fetcher has no per-project try/except, whereas the fake transport returned empty and masked this flaw

The stateful fake transport used by other stories cannot reach real failure modes: genuine JQL over multiple projects, real per-project key allocation, cross-project contamination risk, and the distinction between 'configured but empty' and 'unknown to tracker'

The DC rehearsal must validate that outbound mutations scoped to one project do not contaminate others by dry-running preview and asserting the mutated projects have empty intersection with all other configured projects before sync
Non-existent project keys configured in the mapping must cause the bridge pass to fail closed (per-project search raises, pass writes nothing) rather than silently ignore them

Ephemeral scratch projects (four per run, random RBJ-prefixed keys, pinned template, verified capabilities) must be created before scenarios run and deleted on every exit path, including mid-run failures, with a session guard preventing old RBJ* projects from leaking
